_comment: 🔣️ SSOT taxonomy vocabulary. Ticket 26/08/12/DISSOLVE-KERNELS-AND-MODULES-INTO-EVENT-SOURCED-ARTIFACTS: authored implementation lives at <semantic-collection>/<specific>/component.<language>; reusable modules require two independent production semantic consumers at their lowest common owner.
_semanticCollectionsComment: 🧩️ semanticCollections is the schema-first collection vocabulary. Every listed collection root uses semanticManifestFilename and semanticExtensionKey; its manifest members are in exact bijection with direct child directories. Collection roots are generated/mechanical assembly only. Candidate similarity is evidence, never authority to move, share, or delete code.
_standardsSubsetsComment: Artifacts own standards only. Standards own subsets only. Subsets own schema, IO, and examples — never an engine: an artifact is data plus pure transforms, and behaviour belongs to the app that edits it (26/08/12/ENGINELESS-ARTIFACTS-AND-APP-STATE-MACHINES, #2553). Pure algorithms stay legal one level up, in a module's ⚙️engine — taxonomyLeafParentDirs keeps that word globally valid. Builder, analyzer, and composer remain types generated by derive_artifact_facets! / subset!, never filesystem facets. App examples under 🎛️apps stay app-owned.
_subsetVocabularyComment: 🪆️ Ticket 26/08/11/ARTIFACT-STANDARD-SUBSETS-REAL-VOCABULARIES: subsetDirPrefix/subsetSlugPattern/subsetAnyId/subsetAnyDirName are the shape-only vocabulary for the subset axis (mirrors standardDirPrefix/standardSlugPattern one level down) -- they say what a LEGAL subset id/dir looks like, not which ids a given standard actually declares. The CONTENT vocabulary (which subset ids a standard declares, e.g. pdf@1.7 -> {*, a, x, e, ua, vt, h}) lives per-standard in 🏅️standards/🔖️<slug>/🪆️subsets/🔣️component.json (filename given by subsetsManifestFilename) -- deliberately NOT here, so this file stays shape-only and adding a real subset never requires a script.ts/taxonomy.json edit. The dead single-entry subsetDirs map this replaces (`{"*": "✳️any"}`) had zero readers repo-wide; subsetAnyId/subsetAnyDirName now give the same '*'<->'✳️any' mapping a canonical single source instead of being re-hardcoded ad hoc in script.ts/generators/glue module names.
_engineListComment: Completeness/structural child dirs: artifacts declare standards; standards declare subsets; subsets declare schema+io+examples. Nested schema/io declared via schemaChildDirs, representationDirs, ioSemanticCollectionDirNames, ioDirectionDirs, ioDirectionChildDirs.
_treePurityComment: 🌳️ SHAPE V2 (26/08/05/SHAPE-V2-TREE-PURITY-BROADCAST, user directive): inside an owner's domain tree only three things may exist — a per-language leaf file (taxonomyLeafFilenames / ecosystems.<lang>.leafFilename, always `<prefix>component.<ext>`), the packagesDirName folder, and plain <component> folders. entryLocation="packages" means the entry file lives at <owner>/📦️packages/<lang>/<entry> (three-level shape: <owner>/📦️packages/<lang>/🎯️targets/<target>/<entry>) — 📦️packages holds ONLY packaging code (packagingFileNames/packagingFileSuffixes + the entry file), never data. rootDataDirNames/rootDataFileNames/rootDocFileNames are valid ONLY at the owner root. A sibling variant source file (old 🦀️config.rs / 🦀️terminology.rs / 🦀️wasm.rs / any 🦀️<topic>.rs beside a component.rs) is non-compliant under V2 and folds into its own <folder>/component.<ext> — same module content, only the #[path]/import wiring changes.
_areaStateComment: 🗺️ areas maps an area root to one of areaStates, replacing the registry script's LEGACY_LAYOUT_TOLERANT boolean with per-area granularity. It is a DECLARED value (an area graduates deliberately); per-owner/per-package maturity is DERIVED from disk instead — see migratedMarker and packageMaturityStates, never a hand-maintained package list. NOTE for 26/08/05/UI-ELEMENT-CO-LOCATION-RESTRUCTURE: root script.ts's policyTaxonomyBarrelShapeBreaches compares against the area value "taxonomy", which predates this enum — the equivalent state here is "clean"; validateTaxonomy() rejects any area value outside areaStates so the mismatch surfaces instead of silently making that rule vacuous.
_surfaceComment: 👁️✏️ Ticket 26/08/16/ARTIFACT-VIEWERS-AND-EDITORS-PER-SUBSET: a SURFACE is a subset-scoped UI binding with a role — 👁️viewer (read-only) or ✏️editor (mutating). Every OWNED subset carries both, beside 🧬️schema/🚪️io/📚️examples; a plugin may also mirror a FOREIGN subset's path to contribute a surface it does not own (contributedSubsetChildDirs), which requires a declared dependency on the owning plugin. Surfaces keep the mode/window shape 🎛️apps used, so modesDirName/windowsDirName/modeChildDirs/windowChildDirs are unchanged and now serve surfaces instead of apps. Sequencing (APA lesson 26/08/12): the surface* keys land FIRST and the app* keys are deleted only once the last 🎛️apps directory is gone — the Rust taxonomy assert! gate requires every listed facet dir on every plugin, so a flip in the other order panics all 33 plugins.

rustEntryPathRules._comment: 🦀️ #[path] resolution is CUMULATIVE: every nested `pub mod X { … }` resolves its own #[path] against its immediately enclosing scope's ALREADY-RESOLVED dir, and `#[path = "."]` means "keep the enclosing base". Under entryLocation="packages" the entry file sits entryDirFromOwner deep, so the owner tree is leafPathPrefix away. TWO conventions are valid and both appear in the repo today (confirmed by real compiles: 🏛️architect/📸️remodel/🖍️draw use leaf-prefixed, 🖨️raster uses once-reset) — a validator must model the base stack, not do a flat join.

_stateLaneComment: 🫧️ Ticket 26/08/13/UNIFIED-STATE-ARCHITECTURE-AND-DEMONSTRATOR-RESTORATION wave A0: exactly four state mechanisms exist, enforced by API and policy — 🗿️artifacts = persisted shared, 🎚️config = persisted local-only, 👥️presence = ephemeral shared, 🫧️transient = ephemeral local-only UI state. Every state-owning scope (app, mode, window) carries the same three non-artifact lanes as sibling facet dirs, each shaped by configChildDirs/presenceChildDirs/transientChildDirs. modeChildDirs did not exist before this wave: modes had no declared children at all, so a mode-scoped config/presence/transient facet had nowhere legal to live. Draftness is a LANE property (which store a record lives in), never a field annotation, so `preview` folded into the artifact lane; `effect` was deleted (effects are Emit.effects, not state); and `inferred` left the state axis entirely for the orthogonal `#[derived]` / `x-semio-derived` marker.
